# Paul Irving & Stephen Irving

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — Child of — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — son · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After school finishes, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and meets his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps her prepare for Stephen's arrival that evening.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace
